text:
maya: Heads-up — sketching a proposal to tier API request capture (req/resp) by customer ratecard/ingress to curb telemetry costs. Idea: three capture levels (full-debug, headers+meta, minimal-counts) + retention tiers. Thoughts? @aj @sam

aj: Per-route overrides or per-tenant only? Per-route helps noisy endpoints but increases policy complexity.

sam: I lean per-tenant + optional per-route overrides. Also need retention tiers surfaced in console (7d/30d/90d) and an estimated cost preview.

dave: Major concern: PII in full captures. We need an enforced redaction pipeline before any persistent storage. Prefer structured masks + deterministic HMAC for tokens we need to keep for correlation.

maya: Agreed. Draft plan: redaction in ingest path, default profile strips sensitive fields; full capture requires legal/SE opt-in. Policy knobs: `capture_level`, `retention_days`, `redact_profile`.

aj: How do we route policies across Hosted vs Dedicated? Dedicated tenants should be able to opt for higher capture without affecting shared infra costs; but we should keep unified policy engine.

sam: Edge cases: attachments and embeddings — attachments default to minimal; embeddings should be treated as potentially sensitive (don’t store raw).

telemetry-bot: :warning: Alert — cost spike detected for tenant T-42 in last hour (capture_level=full, est +$320/hr).

aj: We should auto-fallback to a cheaper capture level when a tenant crosses cost thresholds. Proposal: circuit-breaker flips to `headers+meta` and emails on-call owner.

dave: For debugging, ops needs temporary unmask/unredact with TTL and auditor record. Suggest 2-person approval and TTL auto-revoke.

maya: UX ideas: console change preview should show cost delta and a scrubbed sample preview (no raw PII). Also show legal/compliance flag if tenant is in regulated list.

sam: API suggestion: add `POST /v1/telemetry/policy-eval` to simulate policy decision for a given request (returns capture decision + estimated cost). Helpful for local tests and CI.

aj: Implementation note: `policy-eval` MUST be rate-limited and admin-only. We can reuse the existing router decision logic for parity.

dave: Redaction details: combine regex heuristics + NER model for names/emails + deterministic HMAC (per-tenant key) so we can correlate without storing raw PII. Store only hashed tokens and classification metadata.

maya: Example policy proto I was thinking:
```
policy = {
  "capture_level": "headers_meta",
  "retention_days": "30",
  "redact_profile": "default_v2",
  "circuit_breaker": {"max_cost_per_hour": 50.0}
}
```

sam: :thumbsup: I'll mock console wireframes and include an "estimated cost per 10k reqs" line and a sample preview card (scrubbed). ETA EOD.

aj: I'll draft backend changes: unified policy engine, per-tenant quotas, circuit-breaker hook. Quick Q: should sampling decisions be sticky per session? I think yes for debugging consistency.

dave: Sticky sampling helps debugging but beware cold-start bias; rotate the randomness seed weekly and expose non-deterministic test mode.

maya: Sounds good. Can someone take the RFC? I'll compile notes and open PR. @sam prototype console, @aj spec backend polices, @dave define redaction vetting checklist. I'll loop in security/compliance once RFC ready. Thanks all!

sam: On it.

aj: Will start a draft tomorrow.

dave: I'll sketch the redaction tests and HMAC key rotation plan.
